subject: Axios Pro Rata: Weil winds down

Plus, a biotech unicorn raises its own fund | Thursday, October 29, 2026
 
View in browser
 
PRESENTED BY J.P. MORGAN
 
Axios Pro Rata
By Dan Primack · Oct 29, 2026

💰 Welcome to what has become a very busy morning in deals land. Thrive Holdings buying ADT, DoorDash making Instacart official, and possibly the largest tech merger ever. And each of them gets little more than a blurb today. Here we go...
Share today’s Axios Pro Rata
 
 
Top of the Morning
 

Illustration: Allie Carl/Axios
 

We've written about how AI thus far has been much better at discovering drugs than developing them, which is a bit like being great at grocery shopping but helpless in the kitchen.

  • Formation Bio also sees the stubborn bottleneck, and just raised a $600 million "drug development accelerator" fund to help address it.

The big picture: This effort is unusual.

  • Formation Bio is not a venture capital firm. It's a biotech startup backed by some of the world's most successful and deep-pocketed investors — including a16z, Sequoia Capital, and Thrive Capital — and was valued at $1.7 billion when it last raised funding in 2024.
  • But it is definitely reminiscent of a venture capital fund, with Formation Bio serving as general partner (including carried interest) and the LP base consisting mostly of university endowments, foundations, and hospitals (many of which are LPs with Formation's actual VCs).
  • CEO Ben Liu says that his goal is to build a large pharma company, on par with an Eli Lilly or Sanofi, and that this structure will help Formation Bio "take more shots on goal" without having to risk diluting existing shareholders by raising additional equity. In fact, Liu says Formation has no plans to do another venture round.

Zoom in: The fund will buy molecules and drug programs that Formation will then help bring through development.

  • Formation's key innovation, Liu believes, is that it's using AI and centralization to create a more efficient clinical research organization. Specifically, he argues that nearly half of drug development costs come from CRO margins — driven by billable hours — with Formation believing it can reduce spend by between 30% and 50%.
  • "CROs have perverse incentives," Liu says. "We can't really save on manufacturing, which is expensive, but we can cut a lot of the redundant headcount, extra site visits and other things that cause clinical trials to cost so much."

Look ahead: Each company acquired by the fund will become its own NewCo, with any early successes to be sold to Big Pharma. Basically a hub-and-spoke model.

  • "That's only a short-term strategy to lower our cost of capital," Liu explains. "We do think we've found a category that we would hold onto, which we'll share in a couple quarters."

The bottom line: Curing disease is becoming AI's holy grail, the inarguable good that could offset the feared bads.

  • Formation and other CRO startups may or may not help crack the code. But, to borrow a phrase from Liu, it's worth taking more shots on goal.
 
 
The BFD
 

Illustration: Lindsey Bailey/Axios
 

Weil, Gotshal & Manges, one of Wall Street's top law firms, has decided to dissolve.

Why it's the BFD: This is a reminder that a law firm's most valuable assets walk out the door each night, and rival poaching can cause something akin to a bank run.

By the numbers: Weil Gotshal ranked No. 9 among global deal advisors in 2022, per LSEG, but by last year had fallen outside the top 25.

  • It has around 2,000 global employees — including around 1,200 attorneys, some of whom are first-year associates who just joined.
  • Weil Gotshal generated around $2 billion in revenue last year. That's double a decade earlier, but well behind the revenue of top peers.

Behind the scenes: The shutdown decision is being recommended by firm leadership, but still needs to be voted on by the full partnership.

The bottom line: "The roots of the crisis at Weil date back more than a decade. The firm raked in business during the chaotic aftermath of the 2008-09 financial crisis but failed to reinvest those profits and even cut lawyers when many of its competitors were in growth mode. It has fallen behind industry leaders in head count, revenue and profit—leaving it vulnerable to poaching from rival firms." — Erin Mulvaney & Andrew Scurria, WSJ
 
 
Venture Capital Deals
 

🚀 Firehawk, a Dallas-based maker of rocket motors, raised $150m in Series D funding at a $1.4b valuation led by Advent International and Rochefort Asset Management. axios.link/4idqxbC

• Serval, an SF-based IT service management platform, raised $150m in Series C funding at a $3b valuation, per Axios Pro. Sequoia Capital led, joined by Elad Gil, Evantic, First Round, General Catalyst, Redpoint, Conviction, and Headline. axios.link/4e7xSHf

🚑 NeuroXess, a Chinese brain-computer interface startup, raised around $105m in Series B funding led by SDIC Juli, Shenzhen Capital Group, and Qinzhi Capital. axios.link/4kfMI28

🚑 BioGeometry, a Chinese biotech using AI-driven protein design, raised over $100m from Shanghai Biomedical Innovation and Transformation Fund, Guoke Investment, Fortune Capital, Xinglian Capital, Gaorong Capital, and Index AI Industry Innovation Fund. axios.link/4zgcc4g

• Foundry Robotics, an Emeryville, Calif.-based autonomous factory developer, raised $100m in Series A funding. Marlinspike Partners led, joined by Khosla Ventures, SE Ventures, and Wing VC. axios.link/3UNFeJr

• Broccoli, an SF-based automated customer platform for home service businesses, raised $52m in Series A and B funding. Khosla Ventures led both rounds, joined by YC and Operator Partners. axios.link/4eAr5WA

• Opentrons, a Long Island City, N.Y.-based lab automation biotech, raised $40m in Series E funding, per Axios Pro. Avego led, joined by BroadOak Capital Partners. axios.link/4iw8lsK

• Numeracle, a McLean, Va.-based identity management startup, raised $28m led by Edison Partners. axios.link/4ByAYhu

• Ozlo, a Boston-based maker of earbuds for sleep, raised $22m in Series B funding. Modi Ventures led, joined by LifeArc, Artis Ventures, Resmed, Scrum Ventures, Drive by DraftKings, Wheelhouse 360, Wise Ventures, Niremia Collective, Accelerate Ventures, and World Solver Syndicate.

🚑 Midstream Health, an SF-based health-care revenue recovery startup, raised $20m in Series A funding, per Axios Pro. Valorous led, joined by a16z, Foundry, and CommonSpirit Ventures. axios.link/4sDvtdq

🚀 Rendezvous Robotics, a Golden, Colo.-based developer of self-assembling spacecraft, raised $20m. MaC Venture Capital and Toyota Ventures led, joined by University of Michigan Endowment, Astera Ventures, Industrious Ventures, Aurelia Foundry, ATX Venture Partners, and Mana Ventures. axios.link/47NTPaF

• Reflex, a startup focused on modernizing industrial software, raised $15m in Series A funding, per Axios Pro. Standard Capital led, joined by Databricks Ventures, Y Combinator, Lux Capital and Abstract Ventures. axios.link/4Bp1g5E

• Rocker, an AI assistant maker, raised $12.85m. Greycroft led, joined by Anthropic and Menlo Ventures' Anthology Fund, Matchstick, and Stripe. axios.link/3WecMki

• TrashLabs, an SF-based operating system for waste haulers, raised $12m, per Axios Pro. Ventana led, joined by Bienville Capital, Harlem Capital, and CreativeCo. axios.link/3W7m0yQ

• Pathfinder, a Phoenix-based provider of charge cards for families using state education funds, raised $12m in Series A funding, per Axios Pro. Portage led, joined by Reach Capital, Gradient, and Stand Together Ventures Lab. axios.link/48m4tpi

🚑 Blue Arbor Technologies, an Ann Arbor, Mich.-based prosthetic control tech company, raised a $10.5m Series A led by Ottobock. axios.link/4ByeflD

• ShareWillow, an incentive pay platform for home-service technicians, raised $8.5m in seed funding, per Axios Pro. Circadian Ventures led, joined by Lerer Hippeau Ventures, Twelve Below, Notation Capital, Charge Ventures, Expa, and Scott Belsky. axios.link/3UuKK3x

• Mochatrade, an NYC provider of tokenized U.S. equities to traders in India, raised $5.5m. CoinFund led, joined by Coinbase Ventures. axios.link/4kn0Jel

• Bleu Robotics, a French developer of AI models for industrial humanoid robots, raised €5m in pre-seed funding. Contrarian Ventures and OVNI Capital led, joined by Kvanted, WEPA Ventures, Motier Ventures, and Charlie Songhurst. axios.link/4eUlNoX

• i23, a British AI insurance brokerage, raised £4.9m in seed funding from Four Cities Capital, Outward VC, Seedcamp, and Insiders Ventures. axios.link/4sv2jNn

Private Equity Deals
 

• A&M Capital Partners acquired a majority stake in Delta Group, a Buford, Ga.-based provider of investigative and claims support services. axios.link/4Bw6SuP

• AML Analytics, a U.K. provider of anti-money laundering system testing, secured growth funding from Covalent Equity Partners. axios.link/3UNcosF

🚑 Blue Matter Consulting, backed by Baird Capital, agreed to buy health-care comms agency Cognite. axios.link/3WfGi9g

• Cobblers Cove Capital and Arkhouse Management offered to buy Applebee's and IHOP franchisor Dine Brands Global (NYSE: DIN) for around $494m in cash, or $39 per share, per Bloomberg. axios.link/3UUmI1Z

• Hunter Point Capital agreed to a GP financing partnership with Bow River Capital. axios.link/4zVEKQd

• Casap, an SF-based platform for automating financial disputes and fraud investigations, raised $56m in Series B funding. Base10 Partners led, joined by Experian and Synchrony. axios.link/4svWrDG

• Monomoy Capital Partners made a nonbinding $101 per share takeover bid for LCI Industries (NYSE: LCII), a maker of components for the recreation and transportation markets. LCI already has an all-stock merger agreement with Patrick Industries (Nasdaq: PATK). axios.link/3WeTzin

• phData, a Minneapolis-based provider of big data management solutions, secured new funding from existing backer Gryphon Investors and new investor Anthropic. axios.link/4yLoLTO

• Platinum Equity agreed to acquire Chicago-based propane distributor EDP from PPC. axios.link/4sqOKhS

• Thrive Holdings agreed to buy home security giant ADT (NYSE: ADT) for around $15.3b. axios.link/3Whithk
 
 
Liquidity Events
 

• Industrial Growth Partners agreed to sell AdvancedPCB, an Aurora, Colo.-based provider of printed circuit board solutions, to Amphenol (NYSE: APH). axios.link/4eY6awK

• Onsemi (Nasdaq: ON) is in talks to buy NYC-based chip startup Ferric for nearly $1b, per The Information. Ferric has raised over $40m from firms like New Science Ventures. axios.link/4idif3x

• RapidCanvas, a VC-backed maker of custom AI apps, bought Entytle, an Austin-based OEM software developer that had raised $10m from Accel, Moment Ventures, and Shengjing Network. axios.link/4srHQJk
 
 
More M&A
 

Illustration: Sarah Grillo/Axios
 

DoorDash (Nasdaq: DASH) made it official, agreeing to buy Instacart (Nasdaq: CART) for $17b, or $65 per share.

• Marvell Technology (Nasdaq: MRVL) is in advanced talks to buy data center optics maker Lumentum (Nasdaq: LITE), which has a market cap of nearly $83b, per Bloomberg. axios.link/4ipMrHg

• Adani Group of India is weighing a €3b takeover of Dutch energy storage group VTTI, per Bloomberg. axios.link/4BvCwZp

🚑 Chapter, a Medicare navigation startup, acquired Cupertino, Calif.-based personalized retirement navigation platform Hively. axios.link/4A2FyTJ

🚑 Eversana, a Chicago-based biopharma services company, agreed to acquire London-based health economics and outcomes research firm Estima Scientific. axios.link/4zgIUCA

• Federal Signal (NYSE: FSS) acquired Global Vacuum Systems, a Navasota, Texas-based maker of liquid vacuum tank trucks, for around $29m. axios.link/4stdvKi

• Freshworks (Nasdaq: FRSH) acquired Robusta Dev, an Israeli incident intelligence engine for tech disruptions. axios.link/3UXhrqt

🚑 Rho Nutrition, a Miami-based maker of liquid supplements and vitamins, hired Rothschild to find a buyer, per Reuters. axios.link/4sreWJk
 
 
Fundraising
 

• BY Venture Partners, a Dubai-based early-stage firm, raised $60m for its third fund and opened a Lisbon office. axios.link/3UnHFSD

• Lightspeed secured $750m for a new AI-focused fund and related vehicle, per the WSJ. axios.link/4ikTbHX

• U&I Ventures raised over $32m for its debut seed fund. Its founders are Kim Cooper (YouTube) and Kim Moore (Glynn Capital). uandi.vc
 
 
It's Personnel
 

Christine Lagarde said she'll step down as European Central Bank president on Feb. 7, 2027 — nine months before her term is set to expire.

• DLA Piper hired Jesse Sheff, Seung-Ju Paik, and Preeta Paragash away from Latham as partners in its capital solutions practice. dlapiper.com

• LGT Capital Partners of Switzerland promoted Sascha Gruber to CEO. axios.link/4zUQnqD

• Lisa Liu joined crypto-focused VC firm Dragonfly as a partner. She previously was with SignalFire. axios.link/4e57wWg

🚑 Daryl Tol is stepping down as president of General Catalyst's HATco, the effort that bought an Ohio hospital, per Modern Healthcare. axios.link/4yOsuQQ
